sent_bad: According to `doc.txt`, the section "Examples of ISPs Becoming Edge Providers" describes the following actions:

Launched its own edge provider: "AT&T has announced plans to introduce a new edge provider—HBO Max—to stream video programming for no extra charge to AT&T customers who are also HBO subscribers; other customers will reportedly be charged a subscription fee."
